query: A factory has 12 machining machines and 12 tasks. Assigning machine i to task j incurs a machining cost c_ij, as specified in cost_12x12.csv. The objective is to determine a minimum-cost one-to-one assignment of machines to tasks, such that each machine is assigned to exactly one task and each task is assigned to exactly one machine.
